sync.itemTooLarge: An item exceeds the sync size limit
sync.quotaExceeded: Sync storage is full (Chrome sync limit is 100KB)
sync.tooFrequent: Syncing too often; it will retry automatically soon

blockReason.notHttp: Only http/https resources can be downloaded
blockReason.streamManifest: This is a streaming manifest; saving it directly won't give you the full video
blockReason.streamSegment: This is a stream segment, which usually can't play on its own
blockReason.twitterAudioTrack: This is a separate X audio track; it must be merged with the video track to make a full video
blockReason.twitterVideoTrack: This is a separate X video track; it must be merged with the audio track to make a full video
